affinity.title: affinity
affinity.description: Node and pod affinity or anti-affinity rules for scheduling the bentopdf pod.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for bentopdf, replacing the static replicaCount.

maxReplicas.title: maxReplicas
maxReplicas.description: The maximum number of pod replicas the autoscaler is allowed to scale up to.

minReplicas.title: minReplicas
minReplicas.description: The minimum number of pod replicas the autoscaler will maintain.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.title: targetCPUUtilizationPercentage
targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: The target average CPU utilization percentage the autoscaler scales towards.

fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride
fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the fully qualified name of the release used to generate resource names.

parentRefs.title: parentRefs
parentRefs.description: Which Gateways this Route is attached to.

rules.title: rules
rules.description: List of rules and filters applied.
examples:
filters:
  - type: RequestHeaderModifier
    requestHeaderModifier:
      set:
      - name: My-Overwrite-Header
        value: this-is-the-only-value
      remove:
      - User-Agent
- matches:
  - path:
      type: PathPrefix
      value: /echo
    headers:
    - name: version
      value: v2

httpRoute.title: httpRoute
httpRoute.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute configuration for exposing bentopdf as an alternative to Ingress.

pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy
pullPolicy.description: This sets the pull policy for images.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: The container image repository to pull the bentopdf image from.

tag.title: tag
tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

image.title: image
image.description: Container image configuration for the bentopdf deployment.

imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets
imagePullSecrets.description: A list of secrets used for pulling the bentopdf image from a private container registry.

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations applied to the Ingress resource, such as ingress controller or TLS options.

className.title: className
className.description: The IngressClass to use for the Ingress resource.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource for bentopdf.

hosts.title: hosts
hosts.description: The list of hostnames and paths routed to the bentopdf service.

tls.title: tls
tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress, mapping secret names to hostnames.

ingress.title: ingress
ingress.description: Kubernetes Ingress configuration for exposing bentopdf outside the cluster.

path.title: path
path.description: The HTTP path the liveness probe requests.

port.title: port

httpGet.description: HTTP GET probe settings for the liveness check.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe configuration used by Kubernetes to detect and restart an unhealthy bentopdf container.

nameOverride.title: nameOverride
nameOverride.description: This is to override the chart name.

nodeSelector.title: nodeSelector
nodeSelector.description: Node labels used to constrain which nodes the bentopdf pod can be scheduled on.

podAnnotations.title: podAnnotations
podAnnotations.description: Annotations applied to the bentopdf pod.
examples:
This is for setting Kubernetes Labels to a Pod.
For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

podLabels.title: podLabels
podLabels.description: Labels applied to the bentopdf pod.

podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext
podSecurityContext.description: Security context settings applied to the pod as a whole, such as fsGroup.

path.title: path
path.description: The HTTP path the readiness probe requests.

port.title: port
port.description: The named container port the readiness probe targets.

httpGet.title: httpGet
httpGet.description: HTTP GET probe settings for the readiness check.

readinessProbe.title: readinessProbe
readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration used by Kubernetes to determine when the bentopdf container can receive traffic.

replicaCount.title: replicaCount
replicaCount.description: The number of pod replicas to run.

resources.title: resources
resources.description: Container resource requests and limits for the bentopdf container.
examples:
We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
limits:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi
requests:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi

securityContext.title: securityContext
securityContext.description: Security context settings applied to the bentopdf container, such as capabilities or runAsUser.
examples:
capabilities:
  drop:
  - ALL
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
runAsNonRoot: true
runAsUser: 1000

port.title: port
port.description: The port the bentopdf Service listens on.

type.title: type
type.description: The Kubernetes Service type used to expose bentopdf.
examples: This sets the ports more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#field-spec-ports

service.title: service
service.description: Kubernetes Service configuration for exposing bentopdf.

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

automount.title: automount
automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials?

create.title: create
create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created.

name.title: name
name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

serviceAccount.title: serviceAccount
serviceAccount.description: Configuration for the Kubernetes ServiceAccount used by the bentopdf pod.

tolerations.title: tolerations
tolerations.description: Tolerations allowing the bentopdf pod to be scheduled onto nodes with matching taints.
